summary.text: Skip Broussard is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 37 (Calcasieu and Jefferson Davis parishes), and was elected in 2026, according to the official House member page.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Skip Broussard's occupation as Business Owner.
It lists education as B.S., Finance, McNeese State University.

The page lists committee assignments including Education, Labor and Industrial Relations, and Transportation, Highways and Public Works, and caucus affiliations including the Acadiana Delegation, the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation and the Louisiana Rural Caucus.
